financial_stress_precursors.summary: The crypto stress leg decays: BTC recovered to $77.4K (from the $75,064.82 Sep 16 low), 24h liquidations ~$260M vs $570M prior, no fresh failures - while the exodus leg stands (BlackRock-led $746M ETF outflows post-hike; mexc logs $450M net on a different-day basis - basis conflict logged) and demand-signal warnings (4 signals) keep the WATCH posture. Stress relief, not stress.

convergence.methodology: raw_score = sum(imminence x impact) over tagged findings; convergence_score = min(100, round(raw x 0.17) + 5x(categories_beyond_2)); >=100 ACTIVE, >=50 DEVELOPING, else WATCH (formal layer). Hand layer (0-200 composite, confirmed-state rule) maintained separately in blackwatch-macro-event.json and untouched by this scan. De-escalation ticks carry no thread tags (v2.1).
